queer_characters.name: Miriam
queer_characters.notes: Described as a conventional Indian South African wife and mother who discovers personal agency through her deepening emotional and romantic relationship with Amina; praised by LGBTQ+ media as part of one of the best-conceived queer films.

queer_characters.name: Amina
queer_characters.notes: Independent, boundary-breaking cafe owner explicitly framed as a lesbian who embodies freedom and challenges the social norms of apartheid-era society.

contributor_notes: Source labels Miriam as lesbian/queer; she is a married mother whose relationship with Amina is central, so both explicit tags are retained per source text. No creator/crew identity information was provided, so queer_creators left empty. Rep_quality marked positive based on LGBTQ+ media praise cited in the source. Source notes sexism and domestic subjugation as content warnings, but these did not map cleanly to a schema trigger enum; maintainer may wish to review whether domestic-abuse applies. No subtitle or audio language info in source.
